name: algorand
description: The Algorand protocol as one mod. Reads: accounts by address or .algo NFD name (ALGO balance, minimum balance locked by opt-ins, spendable, USD, every ASA held, apps opted-in/created, rekey), ASAs by id/name/unit, smart contracts (decoded global state, boxes, local state, disassembled TEAL, the app's own account), keyless simulated app calls with ARC-4 encoding and decoded returns, history, transactions, blocks, network, price, TEAL compile and a raw algod/indexer escape hatch. Writes: a keystore under ~/.mod/algorand/, payments (with close-out), ASA mint/opt-in/transfer, app deploy/call/update, atomic groups (pay_algo funds an app call in the same group), rekeyed signers handled. Canonical msgpack, base32 addresses, 25-word mnemonics, ed25519 (PyNaCl or pure-Python RFC 8032) and ARC-4 all in-tree - zero hard dependencies. Writes default to testnet; elsewhere confirm=true; HTTP writes need the token from ~/.mod/algorand/token. MCP tools, a REST API and a browser console on one port.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib); msgpack, base32 addresses, mnemonics, ed25519 and ARC-4 in codec.py
auth: reads open; writes sign with keys from ~/.mod/algorand/ (never the repo) - non-testnet writes refuse without confirm=true, HTTP writes need the token from ~/.mod/algorand/token, no route or tool returns a secret

env.PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 51340)
env.ALGOD_URL: your own algod for the default network
env.INDEXER_URL: your own indexer for the default network
env.ALGORAND_OFFLINE: skip the tests that need the chain
